text:
Small piece of baked salmon with herbs and a few rice grains. The plate is square and roughly 26 cm across. The fish spans about 170 px of the roughly 470 px plate width, so it is about 9.5 cm by 6 cm and about 2 cm thick. That puts it at around 90 g. Salmon is roughly 2 kcal/g, giving about 180 kcal, and a little oil brings it to about 190.
